Every climate action should reduce all pollutants in the same way.B. Climate plans work best when they contain only one reduction method.C. The number of actions matters more than the emissions they address.D. Each climate action should be linked to the emission it targets.Write A, B, C, or D - {#4} Question 35.What can be inferred from the passage?A. A region may still have methane emissions after reducing coal use.B. Cutting coal use will automatically remove emissions from farm animals.C. Methane reduction becomes unnecessary whenever renewable energy is widely available in the region.D. All warming pollutants can be reduced by the same single action.Write A, B, C, or D - {#5} Question 36.Where in paragraph 3 does the following sentence best fit?This limitation means that a successful plan cannot rely on energy changes alone.A. [I]B. [II]C. [III]D. [IV]Write A, B, C, or D - {#6} Question 37.What is the main purpose of paragraph 3?A. to compare the warming power of methane and carbon dioxide in detailB. to explain why landfill waste should replace farm animalsC. to show that coal is the only important source of emissionsD. to explain why methane reduction needs actions matched to its sourcesWrite A, B, C, or D - {#7} Question 38.Which of the following is NOT supported by the passage?A. Different human activities can release different warming gases.B. One energy action can automatically reduce every warming pollutant.C. Cleaner energy can reduce carbon dioxide emissions from coal use.D. Methane can come from farm animals and landfill waste.Write A, B, C, or D - {#8} Question 39.Which of the following best summarises the passage?A. Climate plans should focus only on the pollutant produced by coal.B. Methane and carbon dioxide come from exactly the same human activities.C. A climate plan succeeds when every action has the same effect.D. Effective climate plans match different emission sources with suitable reduction actions.Write A, B, C, or D - {#9} Question 40.Which of the following is the best title for the passage?A. Why Methane Matters More Than Carbon Dioxide in Every Climate PlanB. One Energy Solution for Every Source of Global WarmingC. Matching Climate Actions to Different Sources of Warming EmissionsD. Why Climate Plans Should Focus Only on CoalWrite A, B, C, or D - {#10}
